req.title: Basic-auth rejects wrong password
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 401 and WWW-Authenticate: Basic when Basic-auth credentials are missing or wrong.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> must return HTTP 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Basic when credentials are missing or wrong, and HTTP 200 with authenticated=True when correct credentials are supplied. I design: (1) a positive EP test with correct credentials to confirm 200 + payload; (2) a negative NEG test with wrong password to confirm 401 + WWW-Authenticate header; (3) a negative NEG test with no credentials to confirm 401 + WWW-Authenticate header; (4) a DT test covering all four combinations of correct/wrong user × correct/wrong password; (5) a BVA test using empty-string-adjacent credentials to probe boundary of the equality check in check_basic_auth. Each test asserts exact status codes and exact header values to kill operator-flip and constant-bump mutations.

tests.name: test_basic_auth_correct_credentials_returns_200
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/alice/secret with Authorization: Basic base64(alice:secret)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-019 positive path: correct credentials yield 200 + payload
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

def test_basic_auth_correct_credentials_returns_200():
    token = base64.b64encode(b'alice:secret').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get('/basic-auth/alice/secret',
                   headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {token}'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data['authenticated'] == True
    assert data['user'] == 'alice'

test_basic_auth_correct_credentials_returns_200()

tests.name: test_basic_auth_decision_table_all_credential_combinations
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: Only exact match of both user and password yields 200
trace: R-HTTPBIN-019 decision table: both user and password must match exactly
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

def _auth_header(u, p):
    token = base64.b64encode(f'{u}:{p}'.encode()).decode('ascii')
    return {'Authorization': f'Basic {token}'}

def test_basic_auth_decision_table_all_credential_combinations():
    r = client.get('/basic-auth/bob/pass1', headers=_auth_header('bob', 'pass1'))
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.get_json()['authenticated'] == True
    assert r.get_json()['user'] == 'bob'

    r = client.get('/basic-auth/bob/pass1', headers=_auth_header('bob', 'WRONG'))
    assert r.status_code == 401

    r = client.get('/basic-auth/bob/pass1', headers=_auth_header('WRONG', 'pass1'))
    assert r.status_code == 401

    r = client.get('/basic-auth/bob/pass1', headers=_auth_header('WRONG', 'WRONG'))
    assert r.status_code == 401

test_basic_auth_decision_table_all_credential_combinations()

tests.name: test_basic_auth_boundary_one_char_difference_in_password
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send password with one extra character appended -> expect 401
Send password with one character removed -> expect 401
Send password that is a prefix of the correct password -> expect 401
trace: R-HTTPBIN-019 BVA: equality check in check_basic_auth must be exact; off-by-one in string comparison caught
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

def _get_with_creds(user, password, expected_user, expected_pass):
    token = base64.b64encode(f'{user}:{password}'.encode()).decode('ascii')
    return client.get(f'/basic-auth/{expected_user}/{expected_pass}',
                      headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {token}'})

def test_basic_auth_boundary_one_char_difference_in_password():
    r = _get_with_creds('u', 'abc', 'u', 'abc')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.get_json()['authenticated'] == True

    r = _get_with_creds('u', 'abcd', 'u', 'abc')
    assert r.status_code == 401

    r = _get_with_creds('u', 'ab', 'u', 'abc')
    assert r.status_code == 401

    r = _get_with_creds('u', '', 'u', 'abc')
    assert r.status_code == 401

    r = _get_with_creds('u', 'abc', 'u', 'abc')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.get_json()['user'] == 'u'

test_basic_auth_boundary_one_char_difference_in_password()

tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

def test_basic_auth_correct_credentials_response_payload_fields():
    token = base64.b64encode(b'testuser:testpass').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get('/basic-auth/testuser/testpass',
                   headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {token}'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert set(data.keys()) == {'authenticated', 'user'}
    assert data['authenticated'] == True
    assert data['user'] == 'testuser'
    assert data['user'] != 'testpass'
    assert data['authenticated'] != False

test_basic_auth_correct_credentials_response_payload_fields()
